project: Create, install and configure a Yoke project.
project create: Create a new project from a local checkout.
project git: Set up git for a project checkout.
project git bootstrap: Start a git repo and optional GitHub remote for a checkout.
project import: Clone a remote repo and make it a Yoke project.
project install: Install Yoke's files into a project checkout.
project refresh: Update the installed Yoke files in a checkout.
project register: Map a local checkout to a project on this machine.
project snapshot: Upload file snapshots of a checkout.
project snapshot sync: Upload this checkout's changed files to the server.
project structure: Read and change a project's structure settings.
project structure architecture: Draft and check a project's architecture map.
project structure architecture draft: Propose an architecture map from the project's files.
project structure architecture draft get: Propose an architecture map from the project's files.
project structure architecture health: Check code against the project's architecture map.
project structure architecture health ge: Check code against the project's architecture map.
project structure deploy: Read the project's default deployment flow.
project structure deploy defaults: Read the project's default deployment flow.
project structure deploy defaults get: Show the project's default deployment flow.
project structure get: Show the project structure, or one part of it.
project structure patch apply: Apply a list of changes to the project structure.
project uninstall: Remove Yoke's installed files from this checkout.
